product_one_liner.value: CompanyCam is a jobsite productivity platform for contractors to document work, communicate with crews, and share project progress with clients in real time.
product_one_liner.notes: The Company's press page directly describes the product and its contractor audience and says it supports job documentation, crew communication, and client progress sharing.

pricing_page.notes: The CompanyCam pricing page presents a plan and billing details, so it is a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: CompanyCam's customer case studies identify Apple Roofing and Vincent's Heating and Plumbing as customers. | named_customers.0: Apple Roofing is named and its logo is displayed on its CompanyCam case study. | named_customers.1: Vincent's Heating and Plumbing is named in a CompanyCam customer case study.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile gives 365 employees and explicitly classifies the company in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The cited headquarters profile identifies Lincoln as CompanyCam's headquarters city. | hq_country: The company profile identifies the headquarters as Lincoln, United States.

founded_year.notes: The company's press page states that CompanyCam was founded in 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The CompanyCam DEV index shows multiple engineering-focused posts, including Sidekiq request tracking and a workflow for asynchronous Searchkick reindexing, authored by Chad Wilken; this meets the threshold of at least two technical posts.

public_docs.notes: CompanyCam has a public developer portal and multiple publicly accessible help-center articles, meeting the public documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists all ten open positions; none of the role titles includes AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision.

model_provider.notes: A CompanyCam engineer's project write-up says the shared AI layer was shipped on Anthropic, OpenAI, and Groq.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Company's trust-center statement explicitly names SOC 2 Type II and GDPR among its security/privacy claims; CCPA is outside the requested set. | compliance_certs.0: The trust-center statement directly names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The trust-center statement directly names GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook labels the latest deal type Series C and dates the latest funding table row to August 2025. | funding_date: The latest Series C date shown in the funding table is August 21, 2025, represented as 2025-08. | funding_amount_usd: PitchBook's funding table identifies the latest listed Series C deal as $415 million.

raised_18mo.notes: CompanyCam announced its Series C investment on August 21, 2025, which is within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open job board lists an Inside Sales Representative role, and the associated posting describes managing a prospect pipeline; this is an active sales-representative opening.

launched_6mo.notes: CompanyCam announced its AI proposal auto-drafting feature on October 27, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile identifies Will Martin as a CompanyCam VP and gives a July 1, 2026 start date, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.
